question: How many locally acquired human West Nile virus cases will ECDC report for Italy in the 2026 season by the surveillance report published around 7 August 2026?

factors.description: 2025 Italy analog: comparable-date cumulative 32 (Jul23) grew to 173 (Aug6) in two weeks (increments +57,+84). 2026's last increment +26 nearly matches 2025's +27, from a higher base (46 vs 32). Under Week-32 (two-increment) this anchors ~180.
Italian WNV season peaks in August; early-Aug is squarely in the rising phase, so weekly increments almost certainly keep growing.

2026 running ahead of 2025 on cumulative could push a proportional-lead hot scenario toward 230-250 (upper tail).
